svg.title: Catalytic Enzyme
svg.desc: Original nonspecific enzyme schematic with an exterior-accessible catalytic cleft and a symbolic substrate. The pocket is a visual explanation, not an atomic structure or a claim about affinity, mechanism or universal substrate fit.
